{"consolidated_memory":"**Dropped frames in realtime/ws/session.ts — three separate incidents**

File: realtime/ws/session.ts (realtime side)
Test file: realtime/ws/session.test.ts
Stack: TypeScript
Common reproduction trigger across all three: hold a socket open through a network flap

**Incident 1 [2026-03-21]**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Problem: dropped frames in websocket session (signal: frames missing from client sequence)
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #1174, branch fix/dropped-frames-1
- Result: throughput rose 95 percent, to 352 requests per second

**Incident 2 [2026-05-10]**
- Trigger: after rolling restart of the fleet
- Problem: dropped frames in websocket session (signal: frames missing from client sequence)
- Root cause: error swallowed by a bare except
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #1409, branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 12 days running

**Incident 3 [2026-08-19]**
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Problem: dropped frames in websocket session (signal: frames missing from client sequence)
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #3481, branch fix/dropped-frames-3
- Result: memory settled at 827 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB"}
